text: Mindy McGinnis's The Female of the Species was banned pending investigation in two school districts. Beaufort County School District in South Carolina banned it in October 2022 following an informal challenge. Clay County School District in Florida banned it pending investigation during AY 2022-2023 following a formal challenge.
